metadata.title: Liminal Village - Application
metadata.description: Let's get to know you better! Please complete this application form.
metadata.completionMessage: Thank you for your application to Liminal Village! We will review it and get back to you soon.

sections.title: Your story
sections.description: What draws you here, and what you bring with you.

sections.label: Roles in a regenerative network
sections.prompt:
What roles do you have, or could imagine for yourself, within a regenerative network? (Choose any)

• Pollinator — works with different hubs, networking and sharing knowledge, ideas and competencies
• Facilitator — supports hubs in organising and realising their vision
• Storyteller — creates and broadcasts narratives about what’s happening in the network
• Forager — supports hubs or the network in attracting resources
• Hub Founder — has founded, or would like to found a hub
• Hub Steward — stewards, or would like to steward a hub
• Other — something else, tell us

sections.label: Intention
sections.prompt: What is your intention for visiting?

sections.label: Ikigai
sections.prompt:
Tell us something about yourself. What is your Ikigai? (Optional)

What you love, what you’re good at, what the world needs — e.g. healer, leader, facilitator, coach, community organizer, performer, artist…

sections.label: Public profile
sections.prompt:
Shall we put your ikigai and LinkedIn on your public Holons profile, so people can find and book you (e.g. on liminalvillage.com/services)?

Only these two — the rest of your application stays private to the stewards.

sections.label: Background
sections.prompt: Any background you would like to share with us? (Optional)

sections.label: Community experience
sections.prompt:
Do you have any experience living in (intentional) communities, cohousing or ecovillages?

Which ones? Tell us something about your experiences — “none yet” is a fine answer too.

sections.label: Wellbeing
sections.prompt:
Do you have any current wellbeing conditions (physical, emotional or psychological) we should be aware of?

So we can make sure your stay is appropriate and safe for you. Shared only with the people reviewing your application.

sections.label: Referred by

Has someone referred you to Liminal Village? (Optional)

sections.title: Contribution
sections.description:
How you’d like to take part in village life.

🎬 Watch the 2030 Vision again before you answer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XdhPXocPf9g — it shows the network you’d be contributing to; the roles and tasks below are how it comes to life.

Liminal Village is part of a growing local-global regenerative network working toward a new way of living — more connected, balanced and life-supporting. During your stay, we ask you to contribute in ways that nourish yourself, the community, the commons and the village projects, keeping needs and yields in balance across personal, local and global scales.

🌕 Volunteers stay at least one lunation (1 month), offering 20 hours a week.
🤝 Shorter stays are asked for a financial contribution.
🍲 Daily rhythm: everyone shares cooking, cleaning and recycling throughout their stay.

More in the Contribution Guidelines: https://docs.liminalvillage.com
